title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer B = mv₀/(qR) from equating Lorentz force to centripetal force.

title: Angular speed for point A
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer ω = (4k+1)v₀/R, with integer k, from relating ion transit time to cylinder rotation.

title: Average impulse force expression
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer F = [(2nπ+θ)N/(2(π-θ)π)] * (mv₀²/R) tan(θ/2), with integer n.

title: Other detection angles
description: Essential: Correctly lists the final answers θ' = 5π/6, π/6, π/2 (or equivalent in degrees).

title: Ion trajectory geometry
description: Important: Applies geometry to relate the ion's circular path radius R' and speed v to the deflection angle θ via R' = R tan(θ/2) and v = v₀ tan(θ/2).

title: Time in magnetic field
description: Important: Correctly calculates the time the ion spends in the magnetic field for a given trajectory (e.g., t' = (π-θ)R'/v).

title: Cylinder rotation condition
description: Important: Relates the cylinder's rotation angle ω't' to the ion's arrival angle via ω't' = 2nπ + θ for detection at point C.

title: Impulse-momentum theorem application
description: Important: Applies the impulse-momentum theorem correctly, relating average force F, period 2π/ω', number of ions N, and ion momentum change mv.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign for charge in Lorentz force or misidentifies the direction of force/deflection for negative ions.

title: Angle misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Misinterprets the geometric angles (θ, θ') or the rotation angles (2nπ, π-θ) leading to an incorrect kinematic condition.
